udt_struct_v0.doc: One transfer of the swapped-out token (the flashed debt asset) the swap may pull from the\nreceiver: `debt.transfer(receiver, to, amount)`. Nothing else is authorized.
udt_struct_v0.name: Pull

udt_struct_v0.doc:
One staged swap, set by seidar-leverage and run by seidar-leverage-receiver inside Blend's
`exec_op` callback: swap the flashed `amount` of `asset_in` into `asset_out` with `swap`
(at least `min_out`) and send all of it to `user`. Opening flashes the debt asset into
collateral; closing flashes the collateral asset into the debt asset.
udt_struct_v0.name: Staged

udt_struct_v0.doc:
The swap, as a plain contract call the receiver makes: `contract.function(args\xe2\x80\xa6)`, e.g. the
Soroswap aggregator's `swap_exact_in(receiver, debt, amount, collateral, min_out, routes, None)`.
Kept generic so the contract never depends on one DEX's interface or address: a new
aggregator, a router or another venue works without redeploying. It is safe because the
receiver only pre-authorizes `pulls` (at most the flashed amount, never more), measures what
it actually received by balance, reverts below `min_out`, and returns any unspent input.
udt_struct_v0.name: SwapCall
